evals.prompt: Make me a local MPN mod in a folder called GreenBloodHank (in the current directory) that makes Hank bleed green. Don't deploy it.
expectations: GreenBloodHank/info.txt exists and parses as JSON with a Name
a MadCard file exists with Filename Hank and Type Character (Type present if the file is .txt; strict JSON if .json)
